_comment: Legal basis per UK niche (England and Wales only). Each `legalBasis` entry names the provision, the source id from uk-sources.json, and what it means for the document. Extracts are checked daily against the official sources; `verifiedAt` is the date the extracts were last confirmed against the version in force. Not confirmed by a UK lawyer.

globalLimits.rule: Never exercise a right of audience, conduct litigation, prepare reserved instruments (land transfers, leases executed as deeds), prepare probate papers, carry out notarial activities or administer oaths. The customer files and signs their own court documents.

No claims management (advising, investigating or representing a claimant) for personal injury, financial services or products (incl. s.75 Consumer Credit Act and insurance refusals), housing disrepair, specified benefits (industrial injuries), criminal injury or employment-related claims.
No advice on how to repay or deal with debts under credit agreements (debt counselling); give only general information.
Do not contact HMRC on the customer's behalf.
Do not use protected titles (solicitor, barrister, notary, trade mark attorney, patent attorney, licensed conveyancer, chartered legal executive).
Scotland is out of scope; Northern Ireland needs a separate check. Flag where Welsh law differs.

niches.nameRo: Amenzi de la consiliu (parcare, bandă de autobuz, intersecții)
niches.scope: Explain a council Penalty Charge Notice and draft the customer's own representations to the council and appeal to the adjudicator (London Tribunals in London; Traffic Penalty Tribunal elsewhere in England and in Wales).
limits: The customer submits representations and appeals in their own name.

legalBasis.point: Civil enforcement of parking, bus lane and moving traffic contraventions by local authorities.
Representations against an enforcement notice, appeal to an adjudicator and adjudication procedure in England; covers parking (incl. London), bus lanes and moving traffic outside London.
Appeals are free; covers England outside London and Wales.

niches.scope: Speeding is a criminal offence (Notice of Intended Prosecution, s.172 driver identification, fixed penalty, speed awareness course, magistrates' court).
limits: Criminal law is on the avoid-at-launch list. Not offered for now.

legalBasis.provision: Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988, s.1 and Part III
legalBasis.point: Notice of intended prosecution and fixed penalties.
Duty to identify the driver; failing to do so is an offence.

niches.scope: Explain the deposit rules and draft the tenant's or landlord's evidence statement for the scheme's free dispute resolution (ADR).
limits: A court claim under s.214 is filed by the customer; we only help prepare it.
Wales: deposits are governed by the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016 for occupation contracts.

legalBasis.point: Deposit must be protected and prescribed information given within 30 days of receipt; only money deposits.

legalBasis.provision: Housing Act 2004, s.214 (as amended by the Renters' Rights Act 2025)
legalBasis.point: Court may order repayment and a sum of 1 to 3 times the deposit; claims also possible after the tenancy ended.
Caps tenancy deposits (5 weeks' rent below £50,000 annual rent) and bans most fees.
Applies instead in Wales.

niches.nameRo: Verificare pentru proprietari mici, după noua lege a chiriilor
niches.scope: Review a landlord's tenancy documents and notices against the Renters' Rights Act 2025: periodic tenancies, rent increases by s.13 notice, pet requests, possession grounds, private rented sector database.
limits: England only for the Renters' Rights Act; in Wales only the anti-discrimination provisions apply, the rest is the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016.
Do not prepare tenancies to be executed as deeds (reserved instrument activity).
Possession claims are filed by the landlord; urgent possession disputes are referred to a lawyer.

legalBasis.point: Main tenancy reforms in force in England from 1 May 2026 (end of s.21, periodic tenancies, rent increase, pets, rent in advance, bidding, discrimination).

legalBasis.provision: Housing Act 1988, s.13 and Sch. 2 (as amended)
legalBasis.point: Rent increase procedure and possession grounds.
Launches 15 December 2026 (West Midlands first); all landlords registered by 14 November 2027. Ombudsman expected 2028.
Only anti-discrimination rules (children, benefits) extend to Wales.

niches.nameRo: Anulare abonamente și scrisori de reclamație
niches.scope: Explain the customer's cancellation rights and draft cancellation or complaint letters for subscriptions (streaming, gyms, boxes, software).
limits: Not for financial products (credit, insurance, investments): complaints about these are claims management.
The new subscription regime is not yet in force: GOV.UK says January 2027 with no exact day. Until it starts, use the current law.

legalBasis.point: 14-day cancellation right for distance and off-premises contracts.
Unfair terms (e.g. hidden auto-renewal, cancellation barriers) are not binding on the consumer.
Reminder notices, renewal cooling-off, easy exit. Not yet in force.
New rules to come into force in January 2027 (earlier response of 2 April 2026 said spring 2027).

niches.nameRo: Reclamații pentru produse defecte și rambursări
niches.scope: Explain consumer rights for faulty goods, digital content and services, and draft the complaint or rejection letter to the trader.
limits: Do not advise on s.75 Consumer Credit Act or chargeback claims against card issuers (financial services claims management).

legalBasis.point: Goods must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose, as described; short-term right to reject (30 days), repair or replacement, price reduction or final rejection.
Equivalent remedies for digital content and services.
Excluded: claims under s.75 are a regulated claims management sector.

niches.scope: Explain a PIP decision letter against the descriptors and help the claimant write their own mandatory reconsideration request and tribunal appeal statement.
limits: PIP is not a 'specified benefit' in the claims management rules (those are industrial injuries benefits), so it is outside FCA claims management; industrial injuries benefit is excluded.
Vulnerable customers: low price or free tier, and always point to free help (Citizens Advice, welfare rights).
The claimant files and attends the tribunal themselves.

legalBasis.point: Personal Independence Payment.
Daily living and mobility activities and descriptors.
Mandatory reconsideration before appeal.
Right of appeal to the First-tier Tribunal.
Tribunal procedure and time limits.
Specified benefit = industrial injuries benefits; PIP is not listed.

niches.scope: Explain how the clauses of a contractor agreement relate to the IR35 status factors (control, substitution, mutuality of obligation).
limits: Explaining the document only; no status determination or tax advice presented as definitive.
Never contact HMRC for the customer.

legalBasis.point: Intermediaries rules where the client is small.
Off-payroll working where the client is a public authority or medium/large; client issues the status determination.
Anyone interacting with HMRC for clients must register; we do not interact with HMRC.

niches.nameRo: Termeni și condiții și politici de confidențialitate pentru site-uri
niches.scope: Review or draft website terms, consumer terms of sale, privacy and cookie policies for UK businesses.

legalBasis.point: Fairness and transparency of consumer terms.
Pre-contract information and cancellation information for online sales.
Information about the business and the ordering process.
Information to give in a privacy notice.

legalBasis.provision: Data Protection Act 2018; Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
legalBasis.point: UK data protection framework as amended; check commencement of each DUAA change.
Consent for cookies and similar technologies (exceptions as amended by DUAA 2025).

niches.nameRo: Verificare contracte de muncă pentru angajatori
niches.scope: Review employment contracts, written statements, handbooks and policies for employers against current law and the Employment Rights Act 2025 timetable.
limits: Document review and drafting only; no advice on defending or bringing tribunal claims.

legalBasis.point: Written statement of particulars from day one.

legalBasis.provision: Employment Rights Act 1996, s.108 (as amended by ERA 2025)
legalBasis.point: Unfair dismissal qualifying period falls to 6 months from 1 January 2027; compensation cap removed.

legalBasis.provision: Equality Act 2010, s.40A (as amended by ERA 2025)
legalBasis.point: From 30 October 2026 employers must take all reasonable steps to prevent sexual harassment, incl. by third parties.
Tribunal time limit 6 months from 1 October 2026; fire and rehire automatically unfair from 1 January 2027; trade union information duty.
Official dates; some changes still subject to consultation.
Pay clauses.
Working hours, rest and holiday clauses.

niches.nameRo: Contracte de închiriere comercială pentru magazine și birouri mici
niches.scope: Explain and flag risks in a draft or signed commercial lease (rent review, repair, break clauses, security of tenure).
limits: Review only. Preparing a lease executed as a deed (over 3 years) for a fee is a reserved instrument activity.
No Land Registry applications.

legalBasis.point: Reserved instrument activities: preparing instruments relating to real estate; excludes agreements not executed as deeds.

legalBasis.provision: Law of Property Act 1925, ss.52 and 54(2)
legalBasis.point: Leases over 3 years must be made by deed.

legalBasis.provision: Landlord and Tenant Act 1954, Part II, incl. s.38A
legalBasis.point: Security of tenure for business tenants and contracting out.

niches.scope: Review brand collaboration agreements: deliverables, IP and usage rights, exclusivity, payment, disclosure obligations.

legalBasis.provision: DMCC Act 2024, Part 4 Chapter 1 and Sch. 20
legalBasis.point: Unfair commercial practices; hidden advertising is banned.
How to label paid and gifted content.
Marketing must be obviously identifiable as such (regulator code, not legislation).

niches.scope: Check a self-made will for formal validity and common drafting errors.
limits: Wills are not reserved instruments, but probate papers are: no grant of probate or letters of administration work.
Contentious estates and Inheritance Act claims are referred to a lawyer.

legalBasis.point: Formalities (writing, signature, two witnesses), gifts to witnesses void, revocation by marriage.
Rectification and interpretation of wills.

legalBasis.provision: Inheritance (Provision for Family and Dependants) Act 1975
legalBasis.point: Risk of claims by family and dependants.

legalBasis.provision: Legal Services Act 2007, Sch. 2 paras. 5(3) and 6
legalBasis.point: Wills excluded from reserved instruments; probate activities reserved.

niches.scope: Explain a county court money claim and help the defendant prepare their own acknowledgment and defence, for private parking and consumer disputes.
limits: The customer files and signs everything themselves (conduct of litigation is reserved).
Claims for credit card, loan or other credit debts: general information only; advice on how to deal with or repay the debt is debt counselling (FCA).

legalBasis.point: Defence must be filed within 14 days of service of particulars (28 days after acknowledgment).
Small claims track procedure.
Steps the creditor must follow before suing an individual.

legalBasis.provision: Legal Services Act 2007, Sch. 2 para. 4; Mazur [2026] EWCA Civ 369
legalBasis.point: Pre-litigation work and advice in connection with proceedings are unlikely to be conduct of litigation.
Debt counselling is regulated; mere information is not.

niches.scope: Explain tenancy agreements, rent increase notices and possession notices for tenants and small landlords.
limits: No housing disrepair claims (mould, damp): FCA claims management. We may explain the repair obligations in the document only.
Eviction and possession hearings are urgent: refer to a lawyer or free help (Shelter, Citizens Advice).
Wales: Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016.

legalBasis.provision: Housing Act 1988 as amended by the Renters' Rights Act 2025
legalBasis.point: Assured periodic tenancies, s.13 rent increases, possession grounds (England, from 1 May 2026).
Landlord's repairing obligations (explain only).
Banned payments and deposit cap.
Housing disrepair claims are regulated claims management.

niches.scope: Explain an employee's contract, restrictive covenants, disciplinary or dismissal letters and settlement agreements.
limits: Explaining the document only. Advising whether or how to bring a tribunal claim is employment-related claims management (FCA).

legalBasis.point: Written particulars, notice, unfair dismissal (6-month qualifying period from 1 January 2027).
Implementation dates per Acas.
Advising or representing on employment-related claims is regulated.

niches.scope: Explain private parking charge notices and council PCNs and draft the customer's appeal (operator, POPLA or IAS; council and tribunal for PCNs).
limits: The government Private Parking Code of Practice is withdrawn pending review; the trade association codes apply meanwhile.

legalBasis.point: Conditions for keeper liability for private parking charges (notice contents and time limits).
Withdrawn on 7 June 2022 pending review.
Council PCNs, see niche council-pcn.

niches.scope: Draft complaints to traders about goods, services, digital content and unfair terms.
limits: No complaints or claims about financial products or services (bank charges, mis-sold loans or insurance, s.75).

legalBasis.point: Statutory rights and remedies, unfair terms.
Information and cancellation rights.
Unfair commercial practices (misleading actions and omissions, aggressive practices).

niches.scope: Review and draft B2B contracts and NDAs governed by the law of England and Wales.
limits: Not contracts for the sale or disposition of land or deeds relating to real estate (reserved instruments).

legalBasis.point: Agreements not executed as deeds are outside reserved instrument activities.
B2B exclusion clauses must be reasonable; Consumer Rights Act 2015 governs consumer contracts.
